An incredible tribute to my former staff member Asal Sayas. Even in the face of a cancer diagnosis, she worked tirelessly for more federal research dollars and earlier diagnoses to combat the rise of this disease. She made a real difference and never stopped fighting for others.

washingtonpost.com/obituarie…

Belinda Jensen has been a trusted voice at KARE 11 for more than 30 years. Whether tracking storms or answering gardening questions, she connected with people in a special way. Thank you, Belinda — wishing you the best!

kare11.com/article/news/loca…

Just left a beautiful service filled with community members in New Ulm honoring the memory of Captain Bill Bianchi. A recipient of the Medal of Honor during World War II, Captain Bianchi was killed in action in 1945 at just 29 years old. His remains were only just identified last August and his family kept his memory alive all those years. May he rest in peace.

Rising prices driven by tariffs and a war in Iran are hitting farmers hard as planting season gets underway. We need to change course.

axios.com/local/twin-cities/…

A Louisiana federal court just blocked access to mifepristone by mail, limiting how patients can receive an FDA-approved medication. This decision creates new barriers to care. We must restore women’s access to health care.

Little Joy Coffee in Northfield created a raspberry Danish latte so good it’s gone global, keeping with Minnesota’s long tradition of innovation!

Owner Cody Larson shared the recipe online and now it's in cafes around the world.

cnn.com/travel/raspberry-dan…

Wishing Steve Karnowski the best in his next chapter as he steps away from an incredible career at the Associated Press. He has covered Minnesota for more than 30 years and provided steady, trusted coverage through it all.

Drivers in Minnesota are paying $4 a gallon today. That's up more than a dollar since the start of the war with Iran. That's costing Minnesotans every mile.

Video

This week, I earned the endorsement of the IBEW.   

These are electricians and line workers who do the hard, skilled work that literally keeps us out of the dark!  

I’m grateful for their support and, if Minnesotans give me the honor to serve as Governor, I will make good-paying jobs and economic growth my priority. Our state government must carry its weight and match the drive of our workers.

When I woke up 🛌 today…was that only a Minnesota fan’s dream 😴? Did the Wild 🏒 Wolves 🏀 and Twins ⚾️ all win in one night? And are the Frost, Wild & Wolves all moving on in the playoffs? The ☀️ is shining and YES it is ACTUALLY happening.
What a night for Minnesota! Wolves and Wild win game 6 and are moving on.
Wild win game 6 and move to the next round. Now let’s go Wolves for another Minnesota win!

Could the President now do something about the tariff taxes hitting Americans from all the countries that don’t have kings? 👑 

Headline: U.K. whiskey tariffs eased after Trump met with King Charles III
It’s a big night in Minnesota. Game 6 for both the Timberwolves and the Wild. Bring home two wins and clinch the series! 🏒🏀
A new report out this morning shows inflation is up because of the war with Iran. Minnesotans are paying the price every day, from gas and groceries to fertilizer for our farmers.

Thank you to Minnesota Public Radio’s Paul Huttner for your dedication to keeping Minnesotans informed, from blizzards to heat waves and everything in between. Congrats on the retirement and best of luck in your next chapter!

mprnews.org/story/2026/04/29…
Minnesotans are paying the price for this administration’s war with Iran as gas prices rise and squeeze families, small businesses, and farmers across our state.
Justice Kagan says it best

Good to see bipartisan legislation pass in the Minnesota House and Senate. After Colin Hortman shared his story, this bill requires disclosure of chemical irritants and helps ensure homeowners aren’t stuck with the clean-up cost by their insurance.

Brit’s Pub is a true Minneapolis staple of British food and culture. It was great to have invited Brit’s general manager, Shane Higgins, to King Charles’ address to Congress.
